R1 could NOT independently confirm: image-cache-prefix IDs in DOM order are NON-monotonic (15478,25266,26526,24381...), so newest-first ordering is NOT proven from in-page signals. Cross-reference of DOM-first slug vs an independent newest-first signal (ajax_front_action.php home_filter baseline) is a PENDING-R2 task. If R2 cannot prove p.id DESC, fall back to full-catalog-sweep.

stageNotes: Stage1: apex irunguns.ca and www both HTTP 200 (Chrome 120 UA), no redirect, no <link rel=canonical>. canonical = apex (preserves input). robots.txt: 'Disallow:' empty, NO Sitemap directive.
Stage2: Sucuri/Cloudproxy headers on clean 200 (X-Sucuri-ID:14007). PASSIVE per single snapshot. 8-batch NOT run (BLIND). hasWaf=false provisional.

Stage3: custom PHP storefront (bootstrap.min + jquery + custom.css/js, no CMS generator/markers). product_detail.php?p=<slug>. adapterType=generic-retail. No age-gate, no CAPTCHA markers on homepage. needsPlaywright=false provisional BUT Knives/Custom_Engraving/Import-Export render 0 products in static HTML (AJAX-loaded) -> R2 must test plain-HTTP vs Playwright for those depts.

Stage4: department spine = product.php?departments=<Dept>. Firearm-relevant depts + static counts: Firearms 95, Parts_AND_Gear 23, Magazines 20, Optics 4, Ammunition 3 (sum 145). Knives/Custom_Engraving render 0 static (AJAX). Import_/_Export via category.php = subcat index page. Clothing 4 = pure apparel, excluded from firearm-relevant scope. product.php?canadian-store == Firearms set exactly (95/95 overlap) -> redundant, excluded. NO full walk performed (BLIND) -> coverage % UNVERIFIED.

Stage5: pagination is client-side jPages ($('div.holder').jPages({containerID:'content',perPage:12})). All products in initial server HTML. No server-side ?page=N. paginationPattern.type=null (Mistake 15). perPage display=12.

Stage6: NO sort/orderby <select> on category pages (only filter selects: department/category/manufacturer/model/calibre/classes). sortParam=null, sortVerified=false. Persona Lesson 2: cross-reference DOM order vs independent newest-first signal before concluding no-sort. Cross-reference is PENDING-R2.

Stage7: candidate navigate-from-watermark (matching persona prior). UNVERIFIED in BLIND: in-page image-cache IDs are non-monotonic so p.id DESC newest-first is NOT proven. Needs ajax_front_action.php home_filter baseline cross-reference in R2; else full-catalog-sweep.

Stage8: no sitemap, no platform API. expectedProductCount = static-render sum of firearm-relevant depts = 145 (LOW confidence; AJAX-only depts not enumerated). productCountMethod html-pagination via .showing_result (per-dept 'Showing N result'); true global count requires summing all depts incl AJAX-loaded ones.
Stage9: R1 BLIND candidate written BEFORE DB read, per audit protocol.
